meta.description: Reverse-engineered layout tolerances that keep this design bounded to a single A4 page, PLUS the GLIM-C resume-writing guidelines (content quality rules). Character caps are visual-line-budget derived from the PDF's column widths; the writingGuidelines drive content advice + AI tailoring.

global: One page. Use 90–100% of the available space — neither sparse nor overflowing.
Be correct, relevant, and impactful. Proofread; keep punctuation and formatting consistent.
Use bold/highlight judiciously to guide the recruiter's eye — do not over-bold.
Tailor every section to the target job description; write only claims you can justify.
Think from the recruiter's point of view: show relevant knowledge, skills, and quantified achievements.

subHeader.note: job title / project title, 10.5pt bold italic

profileSummary.label: PROFILE SUMMARY
guidelines: 1–2 crisp lines tailored to the target JD; establish relevance at first glance.
Capture your most relevant skills and experience — and only skills you can justify.
Do NOT brand yourself with your previous designation or industry.
Keep keywords connected and broad; don't narrow the scope to one industry.
Bold exactly one key skill you genuinely have and that matters for the role.

professionalExperience.label: PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
guidelines: Heading fits one line: Title | Company | Dates.
Start EVERY bullet with a strong action verb — never 'Responsible for' / 'Worked on'.
Use Action verb + Task/Project + Metric/Result; quantify impact with numbers or %.
Order bullets: outcomes → quantified impact → other responsibilities.
No bullet longer than ~1.5 lines so the reader finishes it.
Put any accolade/recognition as the LAST bullet of the role, with keyword highlighting.
Avoid arcane technical jargon, abbreviations, and company-specific terms.

academicProjects.label: ACADEMIC PROJECTS
guidelines: Each project should convey a problem statement, methodology, and impact.
Use projects to showcase relevant knowledge — great for an industry/function transition.

qualifications.label: QUALIFICATIONS
guidelines: Rows in order: PGPM, UG, 12th, 10th — with correct timelines and spellings.
Round marks to at most 2 decimals (no 3rd decimal place).
No Class 9 or below; no extra projects/internships in this table.

keySkills.label: KEY SKILLS
guidelines: List the key competencies that add value and match the JD.
Only skills you can justify in an interview.

certificates.label: CERTIFICATES
guidelines: Only certifications that add value to your profile.
Include platform, year, and duration in weeks — e.g. 'SQL for Data Mgmt | Udemy | 2025 | 12 weeks'.

awards.label: AWARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS
guidelines: Only value-adding recognitions; list most recent first.
Include the organization and date — e.g. 'Spot Award, TCS, Jan 2025'.

positionsOfResponsibility.label: POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
guidelines: Leadership roles with scope and tenure; bold the role title.

extraCurriculars.label: EXTRA-CURRICULARS
guidelines: Present a well-rounded person with substance and depth in each interest.
Mention any recognitions in your areas of interest.

languages.label: LANGUAGES
guidelines: List ONLY languages you can read, write, and speak proficiently.
